1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hojas elípticas, angostas y duras, que produce drupas negras, con pulpa delgada y semillas elípticas. Fabaceae Albizia lebbek.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub with elliptical, narrow, and hard leaves that produces black drupes with a thin pulp and elliptical seeds. Fabaceae Albizia lebbek.
